snippet.title: Last Time I Saw You - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Last Time I Saw You launches on PC, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox on October 10th 2024.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1909750/Last_Time_I_Saw_You/
Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/last-time-i-saw-you-switch/
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10010299
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/last-time-i-saw-you/9p1lvw7bpmv3
